summary: Tested PitStock iteration 2 (CSV import, receipt printing, vehicle filter, staff roles). Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass (owner-only guards on PUT/DELETE /api/inventory, /api/users, PUT /api/settings, /api/inventory/import; staff allowed on GET inventory/settings, POST inventory/transactions; settings GET/PUT persistence; user create/login/delete + self-delete 400 + 422 short password; CSV import created/updated/errors incl. non-CSV 400 and bad-numeric row; vehicle filter case-insensitive substring). Frontend: all requested owner/staff UI checks pass (Owner nav section, Import CSV/Template buttons, vehicle filter narrowing 6->2 rows, Settings load+save toast+persistence, Staff 'You' label + invite creates row, receipt popup opens with garage name, staff hides nav-staff/nav-settings/import/template/edit/delete). One real gap: React routes /settings and /staff are NOT role-guarded - a staff user reaching them by direct URL sees the owner pages (settings values + editable form, invite dialog); backend correctly returns 403 and UI shows 'Owner access required' toast, so no data is written, but /staff silently renders 'No teammates yet.' instead of an access-denied state.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout/rate limiting (playbook item): unlimited wrong-password attempts return 401 with no throttle.
Seed only inserts admin when absent; it never updates name/role/password of an existing admin, so changing ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env has no effect.

Rows are imported one-by-one with per-row awaits and no upsert on barcode; a CSV row whose barcode collides with a different existing SKU raises a duplicate-key error captured only as a generic 'Row N: ...' message. Also no file-size/row-count limit.
allow_credentials=True combined with default allow_origins='*' (when CORS_ORIGINS unset) is an invalid/ignored combination in browsers; keep explicit origins.

ui_bugs.issue: Owner-only pages are reachable by a staff user via direct URL - no route-level role guard/redirect. Settings form renders current garage data and is editable (save is rejected by backend with 403 toast).
useQuery('/users') 403 for staff is swallowed - table shows 'No teammates yet.' with no error/empty-state distinction; no isError handling on the query.

integration_issues.issue: Filter is applied purely client-side on the already-fetched list; the backend 'vehicle' query param implemented in GET /api/inventory is never used by the UI. Works for current small datasets but will miss items once the 2000-row fetch cap is hit.

issues: No visual issues found - spacing, contrast and dark-theme colours read well at 1920x1080; toasts legible.

action_items: Add role-based route guards in App.js so /settings and /staff redirect non-owner users (e.g., an OwnerRoute wrapper) instead of rendering owner pages.
Handle 403/isError in Staff.jsx (and Settings.jsx) queries with an explicit 'Owner access required' empty state rather than 'No teammates yet.'
Optional: use the backend ?vehicle= param for the inventory vehicle filter so filtering is server-side and scale-safe.
Optional hardening: login attempt lockout and seed_admin password sync.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend authorization is currently presentation-only (isOwner hides buttons); backend guards are correct, but missing route guards let staff view owner screens - fix on the client router.
CSV import loop performs sequential DB roundtrips per row; consider bulk_write for larger files and validate barcode uniqueness explicitly to return a clear error message.
server.py is ~545 lines with models, routes and startup in one file plus mid-file imports (csv/io/UploadFile at line 467); split into routers/models modules before it grows further.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all feature checks pass; 1 missing route guard)

seed_data_creation: Verified staff user mike@garage.com / mike1234 exists (owner-created). Temporary QA data (qa_invitee@garage.com user, TEST_* inventory items, TEST-CSV-* SKUs) created and deleted via cleanup_ui_data.py. NOTE: garage settings 'name' restored to 'Ahmed Auto Garage' but the 'phone' field was overwritten during the save test and reset to empty - owner should re-enter the phone number.
test_credentials: Owner admin@garage.com/admin123; Staff mike@garage.com/mike1234 (also legacy staff@garage.com exists). /app/memory/test_credentials.md only lists the owner - recommend adding the staff account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v). conftest.py auto-creates mike@garage.com if missing. Class-scoped cleanup must only delete its own SKUs - deleting by TEST_ name prefix causes cross-worker races with pytest-xdist (-n 2 loadscope). Frontend: sonner toasts are read via [data-sonner-toast]; receipt popup is capturable with page.context.expect_page(). Remaining known issue: unguarded /settings and /staff routes for staff role.
rca_of_the_issue: Role gating is implemented only in DashboardLayout nav (user.role === 'owner') and inside Inventory.jsx via isOwner; the router in App.js registers /staff and /settings for every authenticated user, so direct navigation renders owner screens. Data safety is preserved by require_owner on the backend (PUT /api/settings, GET/POST /api/users return 403, surfaced as an 'Owner access required' toast), confirmed by test: staff edit of garage name was not persisted.
